g.text: Route Interactive SLA (→ Q_0) vs Batch (→ Q_2)
Asserts preemption on Q_1 / Q_2 forward pass
Frees tensor cores at token quantum boundary
Priority Dispatch Invariant: Q_0 > Q_1 > Q_2
All pending Q_0 jobs clear before Q_1 dispatches; Q_2 runs strictly on idle headroom
TIER 2: HOST DDR5 DRAM (Prefix Cache & Suspended Tasks)
Radix Prefix Tree & Paused KV Pages:
Shared repo context blocks · Cost: 115× cheaper than HBM
TIER 3: LOCAL NVMe SSD (Durable WAL & Snapshots)
WAL.log · Container checkpoints · 9,200× cheaper than HBM
• If t_wait > T*: Evict KV pages to DDR5
• If t_wait ≤ T*: Hold KV pinned in HBM
Prevents bus thrashing during fast AST/tool return
